title: Silas and the Archive
author: I. M. Iversen
blurb: Xanthe Delacroix, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
